title: CreeperRocket
description: Creepers launch like rockets and explode into fireworks instead of TNT
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Qp8xMQOKB1w" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>CreeperRocket plugin:
Turn creepers into rockets instead of explosions.
No mods. Just chaos.

CreeperRocket completely changes how creepers behave:
instead of exploding, they launch into the sky and detonate as fireworks.

Perfect for:

YouTube Shorts / TikTok

fun servers

chaos & visual effects

Features

- Creepers no longer explode

- Creepers launch into the air like rockets

- Configurable fireworks (type, colors, effects)

- Fully configurable launch height

- Custom launch & explosion sounds

- Safe explosion handling (no block damage, no player damage)

- Hot config reload
